$comment: Recorded provider quotas for the SBLA-003 zero-cost model. Master plan 11.8 forbids copying assumed free-tier limits from model memory: every value here was read from the cited URL on the cited date. Re-verify before any provider decision is acted on.

quotas.bandwidth: not stated on the limits page

providers.role: primary static host candidate: request pricing

quotas.staticAssetRequestsQuote: requests to static assets are free and unlimited. A request is considered static when it does not invoke Functions.
quotas.functionsNote: 100,000 daily request quota shared between Pages Functions and Workers; resets at midnight UTC

quotas.caveat: The free tier only applies to Standard storage, and does not apply to Infrequent Access storage.

quotas.usageRestriction: not intended for or allowed to be used as a free web-hosting service to run an online business, e-commerce site, or commercial SaaS

providers.role: portability target considered and not selected

quotas.derivedBandwidthCeiling: 15 GB/month if the entire 300-credit allowance were spent on bandwidth (300 / 20)
quotas.note: The free plan is expressed in credits, but the pricing page states the credit cost of each resource, so it IS modellable. Deploys and requests consume the same 300 credits as bandwidth, so the real bandwidth ceiling is below 15 GB/month.

quotas.cookies: none - does not use client-side state such as cookies or localStorage for analytics
quotas.fingerprinting: none - does not fingerprint individuals via IP, User Agent, or other data for analytics
quotas.samplingQuote: We retain unsampled beacon data for the past 7 days, after this point data is aggregated down to around 10%.
quotas.ingestionQuote: The beacon script will fire on every pageview. The data ingestion pipeline does not apply sampling-every received beacon will be recorded.
quotas.querySampling: between 0.0001% and 100%, dynamically selected based on the filters applied
quotas.beaconScript: required; manual embed for sites not proxied through Cloudflare
quotas.visitorMethodology: counts page views arriving from a different site rather than tracking individuals
quotas.customEvents: NOT ESTABLISHED - whether the enumerated master plan §11.8 event names can be sent as custom events was not confirmed from documentation on the access date
